text.1992년 시작한 신정개발은 산업설비와 환경시설을 다루는 클리닝 전문기업: Founded in 1992, Shinjeong Development is a cleaning specialist for industrial and environmental facilities. We carry out facility maintenance, catalyst and packing media work, dredging, and facility survey and repair, and we send in our own robots for hazardous work inside equipment.
text.전남 여수 (주)신정개발 — 1992년부터 탱크·반응기·관로의 산업설비: Shinjeong Development Co., Ltd., Yeosu, Korea — since 1992 we have specialized in cleaning tanks, reactors and pipelines, catalyst and packing media work, chemical cleaning, dredging and sludge recovery, and pipeline survey and repair. For hazardous work inside equipment, we send in robots developed in-house.
We remove residue and sediment from inside tanks, ponds, drainage channels and R.T.O units.
We remove and replace catalysts and packing media in reactors.
We clean piping, heat exchangers, cooling towers and boilers.
We dredge sediment from sewer and wastewater pipes and treatment facilities, and recover sludge.
We survey with pipeline CCTV and GPR, and repair without excavation.

text.어떤 정보를 보내면 상담에 도움이 되나요?: What information helps you advise us?
text.대상 설비, 작업 목적, 현장 상태와 희망 일정을 알려 주세요. 크기·구: Tell us the target equipment, the purpose of the work, the site condition and your preferred schedule. Sending what you know — size, structure, photos, drawings — lets us give you a more accurate answer.
text.우리 설비에 적용할 수 있는지 바로 알 수 있나요?: Can you tell right away whether it applies to our equipment?
text.출입구와 내부 구조, 잔류물 특성 등 현장 조건을 확인한 뒤에 알 수 있: We can tell after checking site conditions such as the access openings, internal structure and residue characteristics. Send us that information and we will tell you what scope is applicable.
text.회수한 슬러지의 후속 과정도 상담할 수 있나요?: Can we also ask about what happens to the recovered sludge?
text.회수물의 특성과 현장 조건에 따른 탈수·분리 및 처리 연계 범위를 함께: Yes. You can also ask about dewatering, separation and the hand-over to treatment, depending on the recovered material and site conditions.
text.로봇이 모든 작업을 진행하나요?: Do robots do all of the work?
text.아닙니다. 로봇이 설비 내부의 위험 물질을 먼저 회수하고, 위험이 줄어든: No. The robot first recovers the hazardous material inside the equipment; once the hazard is reduced, workers enter and remove the final residue. How far robots are used depends on the equipment and the working conditions.
text.밀폐공간 작업에서 로봇 투입이 왜 더 안전한가요?: Why is it safer to send in a robot for confined-space work?
text.작업자가 들어가기 전에 로봇이 위험 물질을 먼저 제거하고, 작업자는 설비: The robot removes hazardous material before anyone enters, while the operator controls it from a control vehicle outside the equipment, watching the interior on CCTV. This reduces the time people are exposed to risks such as suffocation by toxic gas, contact with high-risk substances and injury in tight spaces.
text.방폭 지역이나 질소 분위기의 설비에도 적용할 수 있나요?: Can it be used in explosion-proof zones or nitrogen-atmosphere equipment?
